note: Plain-language summaries written from each link's evidence list. Each sentence must be backed by an evidence item or caveat in links.json. Later this file can be produced by the Claude API from the same evidence.

calcs.loads/roof-dead-live: Flat-roof dead load build-up (roofing, membrane, Densglass, insulation, deck, framing allowances) used for deck, beams, girders, columns and seismic weight.
calcs.gravity/roof-risafloor: RISAFloor gravity model of the roof (2021): member sketches, then the roof sections of the point, beam, design, shear, bending, deflection and end-reaction tables.
calcs.gravity/level2-risafloor: RISAFloor gravity model of Level 2 (2021): sketches and the Level 2 sections of the model tables.
calcs.studs/hss-hdr-a-1-s4.0.1: ENERCALC check of HSS header (A) at section 1/S4.0.1, strong and weak axis – HSS12x6x5/16.

group/roof/beam/W16X26→gravity/roof-risa.summary: The roof plan's W16x26 beams are sized in the RISAFloor roof model, where W16x26 is the most common roof beam. The match is by size and level only: the model's layout and grid lines (1–5 / A–E) don't line up with the approved roof plan (1–6 / A–F), so which modelled member is which drawn beam can't be confirmed.

group/roof/beam/W18X35→gravity/roof-risa.summary: W18x35 roof beams on the plan match W18x35 members in the RISAFloor roof model, by size and level. As with W16x26, the model's grid system and layout differ from the approved roof plan, so the link is to the size, not to a specific member.
